{{Short description|none}}
The '''president of the American Statistical Association''' is the head of the [[American Statistical Association]] (ASA). According to the association's [[bylaws]], the president is an [[corporate title|officer]], and a member of the [[board of directors]] and of the [[executive committee]]. Elections for the position are held annually, in which all full members are eligible to vote. The term in office is typically three years, as president-elect and past president are also official positions.
